title: Consolidated insight pack prioritization and MVP cuts for Console
creator: Marta Gomez
description: This ticket captures a scoped-down launch plan for the Console Insights surface focused on a small, high-value ‘insight pack’ that covers: 1) a single consolidated cost overview card per customer (route-aggregated) instead of per-route micro-cards, 2) three key dashboard tiles (latency P50/P95, error rate, token spend), and 3) a light-weight traces list + sampled trace links rather than full flamegraph exploration. The goal is to deliver tangible observability for customers while deferring expensive UX and backend work (fine-grained cost slicing, live flamegraphs, extensive trace search) to later phases.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated cost card: shows 24h, 7d, and 30d totals, delta vs prior period, and top-3 contributing route names — data freshness <= 5 minutes
Dashboard tiles: Latency P50 and P95, error rate (5xx/total), and token spend appear in the Insights landing page and update at least every 5 minutes

Traces surface: A paginated traces list with sampling metadata and a link to download or open a sampled raw trace is available; opening a trace loads static trace details (no interactive flamegraph) within 3s for typical traces
Rollout policy: Feature gated by account flag and enabled for 10% of active customers for canary; ability to disable per-customer via the admin console
Regression gating: No increase in backend 95th latency or error rate attributable to insights queries beyond 5% vs baseline during canary
Docs/Help: Short-form in-console help tooltip for each card and a single Confluence guide with interpretation guidance and links to deep-dive features (phase 2)
decisions: De-scope: Remove per-route micro-cards and per-token cost drilldowns for initial launch — consolidate into a single card with top-3 routes
Deferral: Full interactive flamegraph and trace search deferred to Phase 2 due to backend indexing cost and UX polish requirements
Simplification: Use pre-aggregated metrics from the telemetry pipeline rather than introducing new realtime aggregation queries for the MVP
Rollout: Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with safety checks at each step; canary window = 72 hours
tradeoffs: By using pre-aggregated telemetry and consolidating cost breakdowns we reduce backend cost and scope but lose fine-grained per-request charge visibility for launch customers. This increases time-to-value and reduces engineering risk, but some enterprise customers may request the deferred granularity and will need clear comms and roadmap visibility.
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Scoped initial PRD with Eng and Design; identified heavy backend cost in per-route cardinality tests
2025-02-14: Eng estimate session – realtime aggregation rejected for MVP; agreed on pre-aggregates and 5-min refresh cadence
2025-02-18: Design delivered static mockups for consolidated card and tiles; Accessibility review scheduled
2025-02-20: PM updated acceptance criteria to include canary rollback criteria and docs requirement
notes_for_launch: Prioritize instrumentation for usage telemetry to measure feature value (DAU, top-card clicks, trace opens). Prepare a short customer-facing changelog and FAQ highlighting deferred items and planned timeline for Phase 2.
